purpose: Rule-based event-log inputs for the VLM comparison (design doc §9.4 fourth arm), rebuilt from the detector that survived the event holdout: the cross-region sealed readout (8-region LOCO, M65) applied to causal prefix states. Replaces event_log_v0 (hiroshima-trained head, which did not generalise: MS-140/141).
detector: resolution_contract_v2/p4_native_control/holdout_<region>_seed1 (the LOCO readout that never saw <region>), normalisation stats from that fold's sealed train cache
states: arrival_v0/<region>/prefix_fp16 (causal prefix re-encoding, 15 steps) — no lookahead
outputs_per_tile_step: sum of probabilities (for later threshold sweeps)
thresholds: not applied here; applied at read time per region on its own validation block as in P1 (tile-level 5%/10% pre-event budgets)
